definitions.explanation: The team's main catcher, who plays the position most regularly. The prefix {正|せい} ("main; regular") contrasts with backup or rotating players.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正捕手|せいほしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is the team's starting catcher.

examples.japanese: ケガ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{正捕手|せいほしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: He lost his starting catcher spot to an injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{正捕手|せいほしゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young player has been used as the starting catcher this year.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (main; regular) + ⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧ (catcher). The ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧- prefix attaches to position names to mark the player who normally starts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧: starting catcher position (literally "seat")
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be picked as starting catcher
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: competition for the starting catcher spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧: catcher (general)
- キャッチャー: catcher — more common loanword in spoken baseball talk
- ⟦{控|ひか}え→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧: backup catcher
